name: york-2022-satellite
description: Live Earth Engine summaries over the lower York River during the documented 2022 Margalefidinium polykrikoides bloom season (Yu et al., 2025). Runs without model keys.

steps.query: (Margalefidinium polykrikoides OR Cochlodinium polykrikoides) AND York River
steps.reason: Find the published account of the 2022 York River bloom that sets the window
Documented bloom month, first half of the reported window
Documented bloom month, second half of the reported window
Annual landscape context for the year before the bloom
Annual landscape context for the bloom year

gaps: NDCI is a chlorophyll proxy; it does not identify M. polykrikoides or confirm a bloom.
The bloom window comes from Yu et al. (2025), not from in situ cell counts retrieved by this run.
The site is an approximate bounding box; no field validation was performed.
